messages.subject: Published experimental candidate
messages.body: I fast-forwarded local main to the approved candidate, added narrow experimental publication documentation, committed evidence, added the exact HTTPS origin, and pushed main normally. I found the target remote initially empty, no credential/private-key hits in tracked files/history, passing checks (bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run check, bun test 24/0, git diff --check), and verified remote main at 6d938281e5ad6cda8f7ccbf65843adc90f1990a6. What remains is the documented live NOT RUN gate set: automatic bridge wakeup/recovery, old-extension-unloaded replacement, global rollout, and Taskdesk-related acceptance.
